title: Q-SPARSE: Quantum Subspace Projection for Near-Field Angle-Range Spectrum Estimation
summary: Near-field wavefront curvature enables joint angle-range localization, but exploiting it entails repeated covariance-eigenspace tests over a two-dimensional spherical manifold. We propose a quantum subspace-projection algorithm (Q-SPARSE) for super-resolution estimation of parameters in the near field, employing spectral signature similar to MUSIC. Q-SPARSE prepares each spherical steering hypothesis as a quantum state, applies quantum phase estimation (QPE) to covariance-generated evolution, and converts the resolved spectral mass into a localization spectrum.
